title: Escape must close the dropdown menu and return focus to its toggle button
summary: After arrowing into a dropdown menu, pressing Escape hides the menu but leaves keyboard focus on the hidden item instead of the toggle button.
dependencies: vendor/popperjs-core: @popperjs/core 2.11.0 dist/esm from the npm tarball (MIT), mapped with an import map
consumer: Author-written invoice actions page around the unchanged upstream source at buggyCommit; an import map adds the .js extensions Bootstrap's extensionless source imports need in a browser.
